topic: What time does the last Tube leave Brixton on a Saturday night?

text: Right so gig is sat 5th at koko, doors 7:30. Who's getting the tube or nah
I'm in. Do we meet beforehand?
im in can we eat before tho, i'm starving by 6 always
Yes eat before. Pizza place on parkway?
Works for me. Not sure I can get out before 6, work thing
Ok 6 at the pizza place. Jamal you can come straight after?
Probably. Will confirm Thurs
bet. lowkey stressed rn tbh, essay due mon 9am and my laptop charger just died library till close 2mrw
Oh no. I've got a spare one at home if you're near Brixton, I can drop it round
ur a lifesaver it's the main library by the union. i'll sort it tysm
I've got a USB-C one. What's yours?
magsafe 2 nvm ill try the library ones
Ok question. Who's getting back from camden. Victoria line from brixton at night is fine right? Night tube
Checking the last one now
Says last victoria from brixton toward walthamstow is about 00:40 on sat? But I'd double check on the day, tfl changes stuff
Does it run every 10 minutes at that time or is it longer? I'm bad at reading these
On night tube it's like every 10 mins, sometimes longer. Not reliable enough to cut it fine
library closed 😤 went home. charger still dead. got one from tyrone on my floor, he said he'll lend it till tues. blessed 🙏🙏
Ah nice. Good luck with the essay
Who's the support act?
Some band from leeds. I listened to one song and it was ok
essay 40% done going to bed, library at 8
🫡 go to sleep
